method: Nearest raster cell sampled at the bounding-box centre of a provisional OpenStreetMap geometry. This is not a facility entrance, an observed flood depth, or a validated exposure count. Permanent-water cells are excluded. NoData means no depth value is stored, not confirmed absence of flooding; a NoData cell does not establish safety.

extent.area_method: Cell-centre sampling of the source raster at 3 arc-second spacing; per-row latitude scaling. Area is within the display rectangle, not a validated municipal boundary mask.
extent.caveat: Modelled RP100 scenario area, not observed inundation. Permanent-water cells are excluded. The auxiliary spurious-depth mask was not downloaded, so artifact cells cannot be excluded.

limitations: Modelled 100-year river-flood scenario, not observed flooding, a forecast, or an official warning.
Asset locations are provisional OpenStreetMap community-mapped geometry; completeness and positional accuracy are not verified.
Representative points are bounding-box centres, not surveyed facility entrances.
Only the RP100 depth field and the permanent-water mask were downloaded; the spurious-depth artifact mask is unavailable.
Permanent-water cells are excluded from the positive-depth screening because the JRC product patches permanent water into the flood map.
Cells outside the modelled inundation extent are stored as NoData (−9999), not as zero depth; NoData means no depth value is stored, not confirmed absence of flooding.
Zero and NoData cells do not establish safety. Population exposure and damage are not assessed.
No result here is an operational exposure count, risk class, or casualty estimate.
